<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary discourse:</strong> Prime Minister Modi criticized the opposition for mocking his past toilet initiatives, citing a World Bank report noting that 50 crore Indians have escaped poverty over the last decade.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Delimitation debate:</strong> The Congress party has formally requested that the women&#x27;s reservation quota be implemented within existing Lok Sabha seats, arguing that the delimitation process should be deferred until the &#x27;Viksit Bharat&#x27; goals are met.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative concerns:</strong> The Monsoon Session of Parliament has remained unprorogued for a record 100 days, drawing criticism from the opposition regarding the government&#x27;s legislative management and the status of the delimitation bill.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOOGJ3VmRSZTlRVVptckhUT2pTeVZfNHplQXAtSnJWRGNJY2V1WWRZTUVtSU5WeU96Vlp2bkFDLWxvd1NKMHlGS21XNnlEbTN4YnZNeDZCS1hCU2hQLVR5NDM4Qkt0U0x5QmtYZjJCRWdDNjBlcFhuSkxPQVhJU3lNbVI0SlFWUWMzczlMeU5aY29pc1laT3hLNUVpZ2VZSlF6VnJvbVhrRUZDY2UycE1wM2RRQ2lHQW_SAbwBQVVfeXFMUG1NamUwRnRMeXJHSEpqMnljSXQxMUpDNVpDUFhZbFBtT1lKU1RKSHdDM2RfeURlSzVaVnJhUlhiaTZUUFZiN0RGeVRwdU1VdHZ0RzhwMUhydzlKWnpoSjFOWlRQMWZzZDZLWmJNeWtnMVFZc092cmNyMkM5UDBKMG9ES2hic3pOdW05ZWl0OFhjLTRCWnlSSURiTjlYY1Q1a2pIWm5mWVo0Wl9YSE9fMFhDMjJGa1FZMFBTUjY?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Political confrontations:</strong> The BJP has labeled the Congress a &quot;party of goons&quot; following allegations of vandalism by Youth Congress members at Meta offices, while regional leaders have criticized the opposition for persistent parliamentary disruptions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Electoral review:</strong> Following recent setbacks in panchayat elections, the BJP is initiating a performance review, while the Congress has framed these results as a public rejection of the ruling party&#x27;s governance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
</ul>
